text: {"lessons":["Leaving everything unchanged kept me exposed as my account value fell, so I should periodically check whether my holdings and overall risk still fit my goals.","I should not hold a stock just to avoid admitting a purchase was a mistake; reassess it on its current merits and my plan.","Since past price changes do not predict future ones, I should avoid trying to time the market from recent moves and make deliberate, goal-based decisions."]}
